_note: Phase 399, I-03. Agent job labels live in agents/*.md frontmatter as serves_jtbd, the same place commands and skills carry them. MCP tools have no frontmatter, so their labels live here. The proposals came from a Gemini Decision run kept in the private research trail. These labels are not owner-ruled. Every proposal not applied is listed in the phase review file for the owner. Labels only, no probability. Hyphens only.
rule: Apply a (capability, job) pair only when all 4 hold: (a) the proposal p is 0.90 or more (the owner band of D-07); (b) the capability has at most 2 jobs at 0.90 or more; (c) the job is a member of data/job-vocabulary.json ids; (d) the name is an agent file agents/<name>.md, or an MCP tool registered as surface mcp:<name> in data/mcp-tool-connectors.json.
